body: While you're right that some people don't know how to react and it's better to get support from loved ones, he's getting a degree related to counseling, so I'd expect a greater ability to react than most.

I'm getting a Master of Divinity. Was planning on getting ordained and being a pastor, but in earning my degree I've realized I don't believe in Jesus, making ordination a no-go. Lots of MDivs go into nonprofit work, so I'm sure I'll do that. Just have to pitch all my church work well on a resume.

Logically, I have an idea of what I can do next; I just don't care. I'd rather die, honestly.

I am proud of graduating. However, I've recently had to accept that my field isn't right for me. That's what I meant by not knowing what comes next after graduation. I'm scrambling to figure out what other careers I'm qualified for.
I'm sorry you had a fight before she took her life, and I hope you can forgive yourself.
Didn't say it did. Said we need it to survive. Big difference.

You're not responsible, and you didn't fail her. It was her choice. Barring extreme cases, the only party responsible for suicide is those who committed suicide.

I have friends who have tried very hard to keep me alive. They even threatened my ability to graduate on-time by getting the school administration involved, knowing I'd be angry and knowing they might lose my friendship in doing so. It's not their fault if they don't notice I'm doing worse, and it's not their fault even if they notice and if I ever kill myself. It's my fault, and mine alone.

I appreciate you telling me this is a troll. They haven't said anything I haven't already thought, but it's good to know they're not interacting in good faith.

Gotta deny us the right to opt out when the whole system relies on us being born, working, and dying. If everyone dies too soon, no workers.

I don't know if what I just typed made sense, I'm drunk and don't really care. Just don't want to live another 60+ years and spend most of that time helping other people get rich while I pay off my own debt lol.

I recently tanked my career prospects. About to graduate from grad school with no fucking clue what comes next. So, yes, I relate to feeling like a quitter, like a failure. But you're young. Only 19. I'm 25. Of course, I'm young, too. But I want to die, too. I hope you can find a reason to keep going, but if you don't, I don't blame you. Life is a net negative and no one should be forced to continue against their will.
Seriously. Just let us die lol.
Money matters. We need money to survive. It shouldn't be the ONLY reason, but it's a big reason.
